factions.description: Earth-based multinational defense force. Favors fortified positions, repair infrastructure, and coordinated fire. Doctrine: hold the line, deny terrain, protect the core.
Outer-system irregular force. Favors mobility, sabotage, tunnel warfare, and overwhelming local force. Doctrine: breach fast, hit hard, extract before reinforcements.
